youtube_description:
30 years TEDDY AWARD
Tilda Swinton won the Special TEDDY AWARD in 1988 and twenty years later in 2008 for keeping alive the heritage of Derek Jarman. In this interview she talks about starring in queer movies, how she chooses her roles and the relationship with Derek Jarman. Furthermore she tells us what winning the TEDDY AWARD meant to her and gives us some lovely birthday wishes.
 
About this clip
This clip is part of a series dedicated to the 30th birthday of the TEDDY AWARD in 2016. The Teddy winners take a look back in queer film history, reflect on the meaning of a queer film prize and talk about the impact that the TEDDY AWARD had on their films as well as on their artistic lives.
youtube_title: Talk with Tilda Swinton, TEDDY AWARD Winner in 1988 and 2008
